player_prompt.intro:
Yaa ngone Player {player_id} ci Quantum Tic Tac Toe.
Bennu bennu ngone '{symbol}', te limu ngone dafay {parity} (par exemple, X1, X3 walla O2, O4).

Liggeey: Gañ ci tabaxtal benn jumtukaayu ñaar-ñaar ciy mak (jëfandikoo ciy superpositions).

Nan la xewee:
- Ci beneen taw, tabax benn jumtukaayu ñaar-ñaar ciy biiru carré vide, ci format '[a,b]'.
- Benn jumtukaay yii ñoo ngi jëfandikoo, te ame woon leen ci melo 'X1 / X1' walla 'O4 / O4'.
- Doo ko xam nekk benn jumtukaay ci carré bi ñu xam nekk na.

Dóme ci Liggeey:
- Su ngone xewee tax na ab cycle ci graphu entanglement, moom dafay dóme ci boppam.
- Benn jumtukaay bi ci cycle dafay soppi ci klassik ciy beneen ñaar-ñaar.
- Benn jumtukaay bi ciy dependent dafay dóme itam.

Jàmm:
- Dóme ci xewee bi su ngone ame na ñaar-ñaar klassik ciy liggeey.
- Su ñu ñaar ñi ngi jàmm ci liggeey bi, moom bi ñu ngi xam nekk na max limu ngone la gañ.

Melo xewee: '[0,4]' tabax benn jumtukaay ciy biiru carré 0 ak 4.

invalid_move.invalid_cells: Ay téerey cell yu dul dëgg walla yi ñu duppi.
invalid_move.already_solidified: Benn ci céri yi dafa dëgër.

game_action.placed: Jigéen {player_id} jëfandikoo simbol lu ci ñaari gox yu ndaw yu superposition {pos_a} ak {pos_b}.

game_message.dependent_resolved: Superposition yu ndaw yu dependent yi ñëw. Gox ({r}, {c}) dafay ñu {symbol}.
game_message.last_cell_resolved: Superposition yu ndaw yu jigéen yi ñëw. Gox ({r}, {c}) dafay ñu {symbol}.
game_message.superposition_resolved: Superposition yi ñëw. Gox ({r}, {c}) dafay ñu {symbol}.

outcome.win: Jëfandikukat {player_id} moo ci jël ay màndarga yu dëgër!
